abort.already_configured: This BUSY Bar is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: BUSY Bar authentication was updated successfully.
abort.reconfigure_successful: BUSY Bar configuration was updated successfully.

error.api_disabled: Wi-Fi API access is disabled. On the BUSY Bar, open Settings > Connectivity > HTTP API and turn Wi-Fi access on.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the BUSY Bar. Check its address, power, and network connection.
error.invalid_auth: The local API key is incorrect. Leave it blank when access mode is On, or enter the 4–10 digit key when access mode is Key.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the logs for details.

user.title: Connect to a BUSY Bar
user.description: Connects directly over your local network—no BUSY cloud account is needed.

data_description.host: The BUSY Bar IP address or hostname, such as 192.168.1.50.
data_description.token: Optional 4–10 digit key from the BUSY Bar's HTTP API settings. Leave blank when Wi-Fi access is simply On.

discovery_confirm.title: Set up discovered BUSY Bar
discovery_confirm.description: A BUSY Bar was found at {host}. Confirm its address and enter the local API key only if key mode is enabled.

data_description.token: Optional 4–10 digit key from the BUSY Bar's HTTP API settings.

reauth_confirm.title: Update local API access
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current local API key. Leave it blank when access mode is On.

data_description.host: The BUSY Bar IP address or hostname.

data_description.default_priority: Built-in apps use priority 10 and an active BUSY session uses 90. Keep 50 to avoid interrupting focus sessions.
data_description.scan_interval: Fallback refresh interval in seconds; live updates also arrive over the local WebSocket.

clear_display.name: Clear display
clear_display.description: Clears only display elements owned by Home Assistant, leaving other BUSY Bar apps alone.

draw.name: Draw raw elements
draw.description: Draws advanced text, rectangle, image, animation, or countdown elements using the BUSY Bar API schema.

payload.name: Display payload
payload.description: A BUSY Bar DisplayElements object. Home Assistant supplies application_name.

clear_before_draw.name: Clear first
clear_before_draw.description: Clear Home Assistant's current elements before drawing.

play_effect.name: Play effect
play_effect.description: Plays a bounded local animation with no cloud dependency.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Animation length in seconds, up to 30.

send_key.name: Send key
send_key.description: Sends a virtual BUSY Bar button press.

show_message.name: Show message
show_message.description: Shows colorful, scrolling text on the front display and can blink the status LED.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: 1–100. The default 50 does not interrupt an active BUSY session at 90.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds to display; 0 keeps it until cleared.

scroll.name: Scroll
scroll.description: Scroll text that does not fit.

show_progress.name: Show progress
show_progress.description: Shows a compact progress bar for chores, downloads, prints, and timers.

label.name: Label
label.description: Optional label; defaults to the percentage.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds to display; 0 keeps it until cleared.

start_focus.name: Start focus timer
start_focus.description: Starts a one-off focus timer without changing the saved Busy or Custom profiles.

theme.name: Theme
theme.description: Firmware theme identifier, such as on_air or busy.

trigger_smart_home.name: Trigger smart home
trigger_smart_home.description: Emit the BUSY Bar smart-home state during this timer.
